target.launcherDisableExperience: REDlauncher Enable mods OFF yields Biology-inactive native Cyberpunk behavior without uninstall

releaseGate.foundationEvidence: The first integrated Cyberpunk 2077 2.31 milestone proved exact compile, package assembly, clean installation, official REDmod recognition of Biology, and real five-stage REDmod deployment. W13 then proved the post-RED4ext package omitted the task runner needed to regenerate redscript's configured output blob, so standalone cybercmd is now retained as narrow startup plumbing.
releaseGate.reason: Public release remains gated on combined exact build and attended proof that cybercmd regenerates the current final.redscripts, plus launcher ON/OFF, E3 preference persistence, hard-uninstall, body-runtime, Biology-shell, E3-presentation, overlap/precedence, broader gameplay/save/quest/performance acceptance, and final release audit.

components.notes: Biology-owned REDmod identity and activation marker plus accepted project-original runtime and preference UI. Tests, reports, staging, local reference mods and source-only tooling stay out of player artifacts.

Directly required by accepted Biology-owned additive/wrapper runtime seams, save-persistent ScriptableSystem state, and Biology-owned Ink presentation/preferences. It supplies SCC and scc.toml but is not activation authority; player uninstall preserves this generic/shared dependency.

Standalone startup task runner required solely to execute redscript's scc.toml InvokeScc task and regenerate r6/cache/modded/final.redscripts when RED4ext/CET are absent. It is not Biology activation authority and is preserved as generic/shared plumbing on uninstall.
No current Biology production source/data path requires TweakXL.
Current Biology UI uses native/REDscript routes and has no Codeware dependency.
Current Biology runtime adds no custom input binding requiring Input Loader.
Historical research/provenance may remain in the repository, but executing Dark Future content is forbidden from Biology candidates.

Issue #40 uses the local-only Project E3 reference and durable component inventory to guide Biology-owned presentation. Project E3 scripts, archives and tweaks remain forbidden from player runtime artifacts.
No Cyberpunk executable, stock archive, final.redscripts, save or user settings may enter a Biology artifact. Installed final.redscripts may be read only as an exact-compile base.

artifactRequirements: Game-root-relative paths only for runtime payload.
The official first-party REDmod identity is mods/Biology and it owns the inert launcher activation marker.

The integrated artifact contains Biology project-original runtime plus pinned redscript SCC/config and standalone cybercmd startup-task plumbing; Mod Settings, ArchiveXL and RED4ext are not release dependencies.
The E3 presentation preference is persisted in Biology's ScriptableSystem save state and edited through Biology-owned UI; Biology registers no external settings-provider menu row.
Every installed file is represented by exact owner/component/route/uninstall-policy/SHA-256 metadata; shared framework/loader roots are never recursively Biology-owned.
One hashed Uninstall Biology.exe is built into the same release artifact and consumes the matching schema-2 ownership receipt.
Player uninstall preserves retained generic/shared redscript and cybercmd dependencies and saves; Biology preference state remains inside saves because saves are never targeted.
INSTALL.txt documents the launcher ON/OFF contract, supported REDmod/Steam activation, normal launch target, and remaining attended gates.
BIOLOGY-VERSION.txt, provenance, owner manifest and SHA-256 checksums identify the exact candidate.
Required license notice for every bundled generic dependency is included without development-only files.
Blocked or not-required components cause artifact construction to fail closed rather than silently expanding the dependency stack.
Public release remains gated until direct-game and attended acceptance is recorded; successful CI/exact compilation is not live acceptance.
